profile.headline: Sr. Software Developer and Application Security Specialist at SIGN Fracture Care
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Developer with a demonstrated history of implementing software in non-technical industries. Skilled in Software Architecture, Sales, Event Management, Team Building, and Public Speaking.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description: I lead a large refactor of a legacy codebase, new feature development, and infrastructure automation. I help set technical priority and pair new feature development with refactor projects to add maintenance and business value with every deployment.

positions.title: Application Security Specialist
positions.description: In my role as AppSec Specialist, I implement and maintain an Asset Inventory, a living Threat Model document, a merge checklist for developers, help coach my team on security best practices, and set priority for mitigation development.

positions.title: Head Of Strategy
positions.description: I founded a bootstrapped startup in Digital Out Of Home marketing. I created a scalable and cost-effective modular software design, leading the development team in its implementation. Additionally, I recruited experienced sales professionals in the restaurant and dental sectors. As the founder, I handled investor pitching and recruitment responsibilities. I also participated in Spokane Ignite NW, refining our business model, growth strategy, and pitch deck, and presented our company to approximately 300 investors.
positions.insights: Skills: Business Development · Business Strategy · Lean Startup · Technical Leadership · Public Speaking

positions.title: Product Strategist
positions.description: As a Product Strategist, I spearheaded an ongoing collaboration among management, business development, and lead developers to craft a go-to-market strategy for a range of startups and products. I partnered with founders, investors, technical leads, and project managers to identify ways of swiftly and efficiently delivering high-value market-oriented products.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description: As a senior developer, I led full-stack development for client projects in a dynamic team. I wrote a library to connect with a client ERP in the appropriate language. I estimated technical architecture and effort for numerous sales and startup pitches. Additionally, I actively participated in technical brown-bag lunches and secure software development best practice trainings. Adapting to rapidly-changing products, I often switched between three or more codebases and clients within a week. In my final role, I collaborated with a partner to migrate a custom production ERP from on-premises Windows Forms to a new hybrid cloud product, aiming to eventually offer it as a SaaS solution.

positions.title: Member Advisory Board
positions.description: Skills: Public Speaking

positions.title: Business Development Specialist
positions.description: As a Business Development Specialist, I utilized my effective writing skills to create persuasive sales materials for real-time communications products. I also contributed to pricing evaluations and sales strategies, optimizing competitive pricing and maximizing sales potential. Additionally, I provided support for large conferences and actively engaged in lead generation, cold calling, and email marketing campaigns.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description: As a Junior JavaScript Developer, I enhanced open source framework documentation for global developer benefit. My work on large-scale projects involved implementing innovative solutions and sharpening problem-solving and debugging skills. In my final role, I played a crucial part in designing and implementing key features for a user-friendly global music platform for musicians on tour.

positions.title: Founder / Producer
positions.description: I founded and produced a monthly music event and annual festival, booking over fifty bands and serving hundreds of fans. After outgrowing our first venue, we helped design the sound system for a large theatre remodel in exchange for use of the space. Some of our bands included: Joseph, David Bazan & Yuuki Matthews, The Helio Sequence, and Guy Keltner.
positions.insights: Skills: Music Industry · Talent Acquisition · Event Management · Concert Production

positions.title: Web Development Specialist
positions.locationName: Wasco County, Oregon, United States · On-site
positions.description: I led a successful initiative to migrate a large-scale website from Cold Fusion. I collaborated with external contractors, content owners, and departmental stakeholders. Within a year, I completed the migration of half of the ~3,000 page site. Additionally, I implemented a brand guide, provided content creation training, developed templates, and introduced new features.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Design · Consensus Building · Information Technology

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description: As a freelance web developer, I excelled in WordPress and custom site development. My focus was creating visually captivating websites for local businesses, with a specialization in Solar and Renewable Energy companies. I successfully implemented SEO techniques to improve website visibility and achieve higher organic rankings. I designed mobile-first templates to enhance user experience and provided visual design services for aesthetically pleasing websites.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Support · Front-End Development · Linux

volunteerExperiences.description: Technical scoping for software maintenance at international government health organizations.
